checks: Executable, HTML, SVG and unknown attachments only reveal their location; passive text delegates to viewer. Native shell functions were stubbed.
Only validated http/https/mailto links reach the external-browser boundary.
Actual asset protocol serves an authorized image and rejects hidden, internal and outside-root files.
Raw HTML handlers, script/frame/object, JavaScript links, unsafe KaTeX and Mermaid links do not execute or request remote fixture URLs.
Security payload stays byte-for-byte unchanged after mode switching.
IPC rejects a main frame whose URL differs from the exact application URL and resumes after restoration.
Actual Electron window uses sandbox, context isolation, disabled Node integration, and frame-blocking CSP.
